say:1:1530205601:1.text: No, but I heard the Wildborn are planting wheat too.
say:1:1530205601:1.source_cn: 没有，我只是听说雅库伯尔也要种植小麦了。
say:1:1530205601:1.male: No, but I heard the Wildborn are planting wheat too.
say:1:1530205601:1.female: No, but I heard the Wildborn are planting wheat too.

say:2:1530205602:1.text: Most of the camp's food is made from wheat, right?
say:2:1530205602:1.source_cn: 那些军营里的食物，大多都是用小麦制作的吧？
say:2:1530205602:1.male: Most of the camp's food is made from wheat, right?
say:2:1530205602:1.female: Most of the camp's food is made from wheat, right?

say:3:1530205603:1.text: Once the wheat grows, maybe even we'll get to taste Halian dishes!
say:3:1530205603:1.source_cn: 等小麦种出来，水泽营地应该也能吃到呼临人的美食了！
say:3:1530205603:1.male: Once the wheat grows, maybe even we'll get to taste Halian dishes!
say:3:1530205603:1.female: Once the wheat grows, maybe even we'll get to taste Halian dishes!
